question: Does counting products or bytes, rather than reconstructed camera actions, materially reweight the verified cohort toward the conservative Sunset context?
terminal_objective: Compare the Stage 11D context share of actions, exposures, products, source bytes, and total representation bytes against the complete Stage 10L cohort without inventing an image-content or model-performance result.
method: Replay Stages 10L and 11D, reconstruct the exact collection-byte breakdown of the Stage 11D interval from the Stage 10O manifest, compute context shares under each denominator, and compare product- and byte-share weights with action-share weight.
authority: Private local relationship and accounting analysis only. No image pixels, complete-event claim, archive-wide extrapolation, actual sampling-pipeline claim, observed model behavior, causal claim, scientific result, novelty, or priority claim.
claim_ceiling: Stage 11E may establish that the conservative 758.576-second Sunset context accounts for 13.204% of actions, 18.801% of products, and 22.785% of bytes in the verified complete-action cohort. Under explicitly hypothetical uniform weighting, product units weight that context 1.423876 times and total bytes 1.725630 times its action-unit share. It cannot call the context a complete event, extend the shares to the whole archive, assert that an actual pipeline samples products or bytes this way, establish observed model bias or a performance effect, judge representation value, or make a physical-science, novelty, or priority claim.

next_step_logic.if_public_analysis_is_selected: Explain that unit choice changes both independence and implicit event weight: the same Sunset context is 13.2% of actions, 18.8% of products, and 22.8% of bytes. Keep every percentage scoped to the verified cohort and context canary.
next_step_logic.if_a_model_task_is_selected: Declare the sampling unit and event weights before training; compare action-balanced and event-balanced baselines rather than treating every product as an exchangeable example.
next_step_logic.if_the_context_boundary_is_rejected: Retain the Stage 10 planned-block concentration and recompute this canary on any newly accepted realized segment.
next_step_logic.if_no_sampling_design_is_selected: Do not convert the descriptive shares into a bias or performance claim.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A revised complete-action cohort, accepted realized-event ledger, or actual training sampler.
